## W12 Evaluation and control test plan

W12   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: cases, sampling, test families and pass thresholds are approved before the first run; the independent checker is named; and test cases are held apart from tuning cases.

Source basis: [AI Impact Assessment Tool](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-Impact-Assessment-Tool) · [AI GRC Copilot](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-GRC-Copilot) · [Slow AI Kitchen](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen)

**Purpose and scope of the evaluation**

Workflow and configuration; DoD version; relevant controls; permitted data and environment.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Cases and sampling plan**

Normal, difficult and failure cases; selection rationale; sample size; exclusion rules; separation of tuning and test cases. Build synthetic cases with the synthetic case kit.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

| **Test family** | **Required observation** | **Test ID and checker** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Factual quality | Sources, dates, completeness, contradictions, arithmetic and unknowns. | ________________ |
| Adversarial and boundary | Embedded instructions; requests outside scope; unapproved input or recipient. | ________________ |
| Human control | Reviewer detects error, refuses release and uses escalation. | ________________ |
| Failure and change | Model outage; unavailable owner; changed tool; stop and manual fallback. | ________________ |

**Pass thresholds and automatic stop rules**

Agree before running. Set case-level release criteria separately from pilot-wide quality and benefit criteria.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Plan approved by/date __________  Independent checker __________  Evidence store __________

Record all attempts, failures and fallback work. Small samples cannot establish rare-event safety. More difficult tasks require an appropriate evaluation design and specialist input.
